nandana.introTitle: A lifetime spent walking through Sri Lanka.
nandana.whyTitle: A private guide, not a private van.

whyPoints.title: Field-trained, not scripted
whyPoints.description: Nandana's guiding grew out of wildlife conservation fieldwork, not a tour-desk script — he reads a forest the way he reads a room.

whyPoints.title: Nationally certified
whyPoints.description: A Sri Lanka Tourism Board certified national guide since 2002, specializing in birding, wildlife, trekking and cultural tours.

whyPoints.title: One guide, one journey
whyPoints.description: You travel with Nandana himself, not a rotating roster of drivers — your itinerary is shaped around you.

sriLanka.title: Rainforest, highland and coast — closer together than you'd expect.
sriLanka.body: From Wilpattu's dry-zone leopard country to Sinharaja's endemic-rich rainforest canopy, from Kandy's hill temples to the reef off Trincomalee, Sri Lanka compresses a continent's worth of habitat into a single island.

availability.title: Is Nandana available for your dates?
availability.subtitle: Check his calendar directly — no waiting on an email reply.

conservation.title: Guiding rooted in fieldwork, not just hospitality.
conservation.quote: Nandana began his career with Sri Lanka's Department of Wildlife Conservation and remains a member of the Field Ornithology Group of the University of Colombo — conservation isn't a footnote to his tours, it's where his guiding started.
